flows.title: Controller arm, renew, revoke and replacement

steps.description: Authenticate exact origin/profile/session credential and provision a bootstrap.
Bind a provisional controller to current native reporter and channel claims.
Make authority usable only after matching native acknowledgement.
Renew every 500 ms and expire pending native results.
On terminal state, replace bootstrap and reset observation generation.
Cancel tasks, revoke owned binding and release provisional controller.
Build valid and adverse WASM guests with exact Rust/Cargo 1.90.0.
Generate browser codec artifacts from the contract.
Require schema, roles, exact revision and per-file hashes.
Stage source-only payload, forbid native/managed binaries and create deterministic archive/hash.
Run the environment-dependent native receiver proof.

facts.statement: The live browser caps frames at 64 KiB, actors at 64, modules at 8 MiB and queued inputs at 8.
Tactical bootstrap requires revision 1 capabilities and a complete bounded catalogue with unique valid definitions.
Browser intent actors must be unique current owned lifetimes at the acknowledged observation basis.
Tactical queue operations require a complete queue and an exact current queue revision.
The supervisor permits one pending guest request and invalidates it when the worker generation changes.
Each guest phase has a 250 millisecond watchdog.
Guest modules have no imports or start function, one bounded non-shared memory, at most one bounded table, and an exact export/signature set.
The worker validates aligned bounded non-overlapping ranges and copies guest output before freeing guest memory.
Guest responses must match input, session, module generation and basis and acknowledge consumption.
The live gateway requires loopback HTTP, exact origin/path, a nonempty session credential and positive bounds.
On an observation gap, the gateway retains last complete facts and marks them stale instead of inventing a snapshot.
Live control and command channels are single claimant resources and release is fenced by incarnation.
A provisional browser controller is not usable until a matching native control acknowledgement confirms it.
Live admission reserves parent and all native child identities before publishing the command, preserving broker admission before native lifecycle reporting.
Ordinary gameplay admission is rejected while live authority is armed, native-active or revoking.
Writing a batch to the HighBar stream is delivery only; native batch acceptance is reported independently.
Native admission maps to Accepted or Rejected, deadline expiry maps to Unknown, and dispatch separately maps to Applied or Skipped.
Completed parent and native result identities are retained in bounded process memory for duplicate/late classification.
Typed audit events are written to rolling daily structured broker log files.
The inspected source has no durable replay path that reconstructs live controller, pending parent or result history after broker restart.
Build maps a catalogue-bound definition, position and facing to native tactical commands.
Guard, repair and unit reclaim require current friendly target lifetimes; feature reclaim requires a current feature lifetime.
Area reclaim validates a finite in-bounds center and a positive capability-bounded radius.
Factory production validates a current complete queue and expands requested count into native children with unit command count.
A factory rally target maps to a native move-unit command after descriptor and bounds validation.
Adverse and valid WASM fixtures are built with exact Cargo 1.90.0 and the wasm32-unknown-unknown target.
Receiver packaging requires an exact clean source revision and exact hashes for every pinned payload file.
The live receiver archive rejects native and managed assemblies and uses deterministic archive metadata.
Genuine native receiver journeys are environment-dependent qualification routes rather than a default hermetic test.
The process launcher source records that real executable display flags still require validation.

open_questions: What durable store and recovery protocol should reconstruct live authority and pending outcomes after a broker restart?
Which full action/unit/queue/engine-version matrix is required for genuine native acceptance beyond the selected NativeProof journeys?
What operational retention and backpressure sizes are valid for long live sessions under measured workloads?
Which real BAR executable and display flags are accepted in each supported deployment environment?
How will schema, generated codec and receiver pin/hash updates be made indivisible in the release process?
